coordinate_evidence: Delivered MAP visualization CSV uses x~0.44 m, radius~0.326 m; do not apply CAD mm conversion to MAP output coordinates.
boundary_source: Delivered dataset README.md section 2, uniform solver settings; not inferred from solved monitor quantities. Per-case native boundary files are not included in the local delivery.
input_policy: Coordinates plus the declared constant boundary vector only. Design metadata and solved performance quantities are not automatic model inputs.
duplicate_coordinate_policy: Retain all block nodes and interface copies; no deduplication or implied connectivity across blocks.
integer_flag_policy: Retain raw values and presence mask without interpretation or node filtering.
normalization_policy: Record coordinate bounds and target moments from train only; cached targets remain in physical units. Final scaling is a training-adapter decision.
